body: Commit 6330631 (+ CHANGELOG). scripts/rl_train.py trains a small MLP policy via PPO against the ArenaTrainingEnv, same CLI/env-var delivery pattern as colab_train.py, parallel SubprocVecEnv envs, periodic+final checkpoints, real win/loss/draw evaluation. Same honest gap as S170-225: stable_baselines3 not installable here, training loop written to spec but not live-tested.
title: S170-226: PPO training script (Stable-Baselines3)
